Hi Grace,

Thanks again for taking this on. As part of our SOC 2 readiness review and the SIG questionnaire we're finishing up, we need the following artifacts from Redwood for the MedBridge account: 

- SCIM delta sync logs for the last 30 days (creation, update, deprovision events; timestamps and actor).

Can you deliver these by 2026-05-14? Our compliance window is tight — final questionnaire is due 2026-05-31. I've attached the SIG questions that reference these artifacts for context.

If you need a short call to walk through formats, I can make time tomorrow morning.

- SAML samples include the Assertion and the raw Base64-encoded form as we pass it to the SP; we redacted any live session IDs.
- RBAC export is a point-in-time CSV from 2026-05-04; for production audits we can run an incremental export if you need a different window.
